passage.text: Mr. Brown's mother lives in Canada, and her birthday is in March.
passage.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊnz ˈmʌðər ˈlɪvz ɪn ˈkænədə, ənd hɜːr ˈbɜːrθdeɪ ɪz ɪn ˈmɑːrtʃ.

passage.text: In February, Mr. Brown bought her a beautiful silk scarf.
passage.reading: ɪn ˈfɛbruɛri, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈbɔːt hɜːr ə ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈsɪlk ˈskɑːrf.

passage.text: He wrapped it and packed it in a small box.
passage.reading: hiː ˈræpt ɪt ənd ˈpækt ɪt ɪn ə ˈsmɔːl ˈbɑːks.

passage.text: Then he sent the box to Canada by airmail.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn hiː ˈsɛnt ðə ˈbɑːks tə ˈkænədə baɪ ˈɛrmeɪl.

passage.text: It usually takes about ten days, but this time it took five weeks!
passage.reading: ɪt ˈjuːʒuəli ˈteɪks əˈbaʊt ˈtɛn ˈdeɪz, bʌt ðɪs ˈtaɪm ɪt ˈtʊk ˈfaɪv ˈwiːks!

passage.text: The box stayed at customs in Canada for a long time.
passage.reading: ðə ˈbɑːks ˈsteɪd ət ˈkʌstəmz ɪn ˈkænədə fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: His mother received it in April, two weeks after her birthday.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈmʌðər rɪˈsiːvd ɪt ɪn ˈeɪprəl, ˈtuː ˈwiːks ˈæftər hɜːr ˈbɜːrθdeɪ.

passage.text: Mr. Brown felt sad, but his mother loved the scarf.
passage.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈfɛlt ˈsæd, bʌt hɪz ˈmʌðər ˈlʌvd ðə ˈskɑːrf.

passage.text: Next year, he's going to mail her package in January!
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, hiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈmeɪl hɜːr ˈpækɪdʒ ɪn ˈdʒænjuɛri!
